description:
Get all links connected to a specific highlight.

Returns parent links (where this highlight is referenced by others)
and child links (where this highlight references others).
Useful for exploring how a specific idea connects to other highlights.

params.description: Parameters for getting links for a specific highlight.

direction.description: Direction: 'parent' (links where this highlight is the context/target), 'child' (links where this highlight is the actor), or 'both'

highlight_id.description: Highlight UUID to get links for

include_details.description: Include linked highlight text and page details

name: highlyt_get_highlight_links
title: Get Highlight Links
